name: high_error_rate

query_condition.sql: SELECT k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name, count(*) as cnt FROM "k8s_logs" WHERE body LIKE '%error%' GROUP BY k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name HAVING cnt > 15

description: Warning: High error log volume in {k8s_namespace_name}/{k8s_pod_name} (>15 lines matching 'error' over 5m; the loki-ruler rule was >3/s sustained 2m — retuned to counts for O2 SQL). Stream renamed default → k8s_logs: the logs pipeline writes to k8s_logs, no default stream exists (cmdshift/platform#206).
